query:
SELECT
                id,
                cmd,
                continue_on_error
            FROM command_queue
            WHERE device_id = $1 AND fetched = false AND canceled = false AND available_at <= now()
              AND NOT (
                  cmd::jsonb = '"Restart"'::jsonb
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM device_restart_channel c
                      WHERE c.device_id = $1 AND c.last_poll_at > now() - $2::text::interval
                  )
              )
